name: cross-profile-favourites-get-their-icons
description:
Two spaces on two profiles, each with favourites on real origins. The app launches on the Default space, whose tiles resolve through the site fetch under the Default presenter. Cmd+2 then moves to the Profile 1 space. Its favourites were already asked under Default, but the second profile draws its own grid and reads its own icon scope, so the report 'a lot of favourite favicons are missing in BPX and Eventim' is about what this switch shows.

The visible-tiles eval names every favourite tile that is actually on screen after the switch, with whether its icon loaded, which is the evidence the report needs.

actions.expression: (() => { const vis = [...document.querySelectorAll('.fav')].filter(f => { const r = f.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && getComputedStyle(f).visibility !== 'hidden' && r.left >= 0 && r.right <= innerWidth; }); return String(vis.length > 0 && vis.every(f => f.querySelector('.fvimg.ok'))); })()
actions.note: the startup space's own tiles paint under its own presenter

actions.expression: (() => { return [...document.querySelectorAll('.fav')].filter(f => { const r = f.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && getComputedStyle(f).visibility !== 'hidden' && r.left >= 0 && r.right <= innerWidth; }).map(f => { const i = f.querySelector('.fvimg'); const grid = f.parentElement; const where = grid.parentElement && grid.parentElement.classList.contains('railpane') ? 'pane' : 'pinned'; return (f.dataset.favId || '?').replace(/^https:\/\//, '').slice(0, 24) + '@' + where + '=' + (i ? (i.classList.contains('ok') ? 'ok' : 'img') : 'none'); }).join(' ') || 'no visible tiles'; })()
actions.note: recorded: every tile on screen after the switch, which grid it belongs to, and whether its icon loaded

actions.expression: document.getElementById('atrium-root').className + ' | pinned grid profile=' + (document.querySelector('#atrium-root > .favgrid')?.dataset.profileId || 'none') + ' | pinned tiles=' + document.querySelectorAll('#atrium-root > .favgrid .fav').length + ' | scope=' + (document.querySelector('#atrium-root > .favgrid .fvimg')?.src || 'no img').replace(/.*urlicon\/([0-9A-F]{8}).*/, '$1')
actions.note: recorded: the root's gate classes, which profile the pinned grid was drawn for, and the scope its images ask

actions.expression: (() => { const vis = [...document.querySelectorAll('.fav')].filter(f => { const r = f.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && getComputedStyle(f).visibility !== 'hidden' && r.left >= 0 && r.right <= innerWidth; }); const ids = new Set(vis.map(f => f.dataset.favId)); return String(ids.size >= 5 && vis.every(f => f.querySelector('.fvimg.ok'))); })()
actions.note: the five Profile 1 favourites are on screen with their icons

assertions.desc: the second profile's tiles paint after the switch
